nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Set this workflow as the 'Error Workflow' in Workflow Settings on every one of the other 9 workflows AFTER importing all of them (the workflow id only exists post-import) — see n8n/README.md 'Import order'. This is the last-resort safety net for an uncaught n8n crash — normal provider-send failures are already handled by each executor's own retryOnFail + reporting to Workflow 06, which is where real business retry/backoff lives (in the backend).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ outcome: 'failure', error: 'n8n execution crashed: ' + $json.errorMessage, retryable: true }) }}

nodes.name: Report Failure To Backend
nodes.notes: Only usable for send_email/send_whatsapp actions — /result rejects a success report for internal action types, but a failure report is accepted for any type, which is all this safety net ever sends. Backend-owned retry/backoff bookkeeping takes over from here exactly as it would for a normal reported failure.
